verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show the product reporting per-run success, duration, or token or dollar cost for an operator's own runs. The closest items are adjacent features: workflow templates listed with aggregate success rates and run counts, a progress event stream, and live viewing of the cloud computers. None of these is a per-run metrics report that lets an operator compare runs.

support.subject: As an operator, per-run metrics (success, duration, token or dollar cost) are reported, so I can compare runs
